title: THE CONSTITUTIONAL BOT
about: A Ranger talks his way past a door-guard robot that thinks in constitutional law: the purpose chain, the emergency, the robot's warning about necessity and tyranny, the preamble that opens the lock, and the strongly worded opinion it promises on his way through.

beats.text: A rusted service corridor deep inside Vault 360. The Ranger Stryder needs the control room. Between him and it stands a blast door, and the machine that guards it.
HALT, CITIZEN OR OTHER ENTITY. DECLARE YOUR STANDING.
Good evening, honored instrument of civic virtue.
FLATTERY IS NOT A POWER ENUMERATED.
So Stryder argues the old way, one premise at a time. The robot assents to each. Then it asks for his authority, and he has only a forged paper.
see: a man holding up a folded paper
a rubber stamp coming down on a document

beats.text: Tell me, Madison-Unit… do you exist to serve the letter of the law, or the spirit?
THE LAW HAS NO SPIRIT. IT HAS PROCEDURE.
A procedure has a purpose.
ITS PURPOSE IS COMPLIANCE.
And the purpose of compliance is—
…STABILITY.
And the purpose of stability is?
…THE CONTINUANCE OF THE COMMONWEALTH.

beats.ask: you have to ask what it's all for

beats.text: Down the corridor, something screams in the vents, and the floor shakes. The Death-Grill, the furnace at the Vault's heart, is overheating.
see: a furnace glowing in the dark

beats.text: The Death-Grill is overheating. If it vents, the Vault becomes a brisket.
BRISKET IS NOT A CONSTITUTIONAL CATEGORY.
It will be.
YOUR ARGUMENT INVOKES NECESSITY. NECESSITY IS A DOOR THROUGH WHICH TYRANNY ENTERS.

beats.ask: in an emergency you do what you have to do

beats.text: Stryder points at the camera filming them: the entry can be reviewed, so it is lawful. The robot objects. Being recorded does not make a thing legitimate.
see: a security camera mounted on a wall
a judge listening at the bench

beats.text: Then we refine. Tell me, Madison-Unit… what is the highest legitimate authority in this Vault?
THE CONSTITUTION.
And what is the Constitution for?
…TO FORM A MORE PERFECT UNION. TO ESTABLISH JUSTICE. TO ENSURE DOMESTIC TRANQUILITY—
Domestic tranquility is currently being threatened by an overheating Death-Grill and screaming entities in your ventilation shafts.
THAT… IS FACTUAL.
So if the Constitution’s purpose is domestic tranquility, and my entry prevents imminent brisketization, then my entry serves the Constitution’s purpose. Therefore… it is constitutional.

beats.ask: he talked his way right through that door

beats.text: The robot's screen prints its verdict: rationally compelling. The locks open one by one, and the great door swings wide.
see: a heavy steel door swinging open

beats.text: ACCESS GRANTED UNDER THE DOCTRINE OF NECESSARY VIRTUE. YOU ARE HEREBY TEMPORARILY COMMISSIONED AS— A PERSON I DISAGREE WITH.
NOTE FOR THE RECORD: IF YOU BECOME A TYRANT, I WILL WRITE A VERY STRONGLY WORDED OPINION.
Make it concise. The world’s ending.
Inside, the control room hums. At its center glows a lever marked Sun, simulated, do not touch. Stryder draws his blade and reaches for it anyway.
see: a large lever on a control panel
a man reaching for a switch
